description: Price near the top of its recent range, momentum decelerating despite elevated price, high volume with a stalling 7D return, extremely positive (crowded-long) funding, high crowding score, range-bound structure near the highs. A textbook distribution day — every distribution rule clears.
how_this_was_generated: Computed by actually running Bitmomo_Regime_Input::validate() and Bitmomo_Regime_Classifier::evaluate() against normalized_input below — not hand-derived. Re-run any time the classifier or config changes.

expected.confidence_range_note: Score is 100/100 (max), clamped at CONFIDENCE_CEILING=97. Weaker real payloads will legitimately score lower — assert 'within confidence_range', not an exact number.
evidence: Price near the top of its recent range (85 pctl).
High volume (72 pctl) with a stalling 7D return (1%).
Funding rate extremely positive — crowded long (0.1%).
Structure state is range-bound near the highs.

notes: The funding-rate evidence line reads '(0.1%)' even though funding_rate_pct is 0.07 (i.e. 7%). Same root cause as the accumulation fixture's note: Bitmomo_Regime_Classifier::fmt() rounds the RAW fraction to 1 decimal without multiplying by 100. Any funding_rate_pct >= 0.05 (the DIST_EXTREME_FUNDING_POS threshold) will render as '0.1%' in evidence text regardless of how far above 0.05 it actually is. Do not parse the evidence string for the real funding magnitude — read normalized_input.funding_rate_pct instead. See FIELD_SEMANTICS.md and the security/defect audit for the full note.

This fixture's structure_state is 'range', not a distribution-specific state — Product A has no distinct 'distribution' structure_state value (STRUCTURE_STATES = range/breakout_up/breakout_down/breakdown/unknown). Distribution is a range_position_pct + momentum + volume + funding/crowding pattern, not a structure_state value on its own; do not expect the classifier to ever require structure_state to equal something like 'distribution'.
